note: Hand-authored fixture. Support ticket that surfaces an expansion signal; an account manager joins mid-call.

speakerNames.label: Customer
speakerNames.name: Priya
speakerNames.quote: Thanks for holding, Priya. Right, I've got your ticket up. You're hitting the upload limit.

speakerNames.label: Account Manager
speakerNames.name: Nadia
speakerNames.quote: Hi, it's Nadia. I caught the end of that — you've added a team and outgrown the plan.

segments.speaker: Support
segments.text: Thanks for holding, Priya. Right, I've got your ticket up. You're hitting the upload limit.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Every day this week. It just stops taking calls about three in the afternoon.

segments.speaker: Support
segments.text: Yeah, that matches what I'm seeing here. So you're on the plan that caps at two hundred calls a month, and you're at two hundred and forty.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Two hundred and forty? That can't be right.

segments.speaker: Support
segments.text: It is, I'm afraid. Your volume roughly doubled about six weeks ago.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Six weeks — oh. That'll be Manchester coming on.

segments.speaker: Support
segments.text: That'd do it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: I genuinely didn't think about a ceiling. Nobody mentioned one.

segments.speaker: Support
segments.text: No, understood. Look, I can lift the cap for the rest of this month so you're not blocked while you sort it out properly.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Please. Because the reps are working around it, and that's worse than not having it.

segments.speaker: Support
segments.text: Working around it how, sorry?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Taking their own notes again. Which is the thing we bought you to stop them doing.

segments.speaker: Support
segments.text: Yeah. Okay, cap's lifted, that's done now — can you try an upload?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Erm. Yeah, that's gone through. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Support
segments.text: Good. Can I bring Nadia in? She looks after your account. This is a plan thing really, not a bug.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: As long as it's not a pitch.

segments.speaker: Support
segments.text: No, no.

segments.speaker: Account Manager
segments.text: Hi, it's Nadia. I caught the end of that — you've added a team and outgrown the plan.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: We put eleven people in Manchester on it. And nobody told us there was a limit.

segments.speaker: Account Manager
segments.text: No, and that's on us. You should've heard about that from me when your volume changed, not from a failed upload.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: I appreciate you saying that. It's been a bad week for the team's confidence in it, to be honest.

segments.speaker: Account Manager
segments.text: I can imagine. What would make that right, other than the cap?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Knowing it won't happen again, really. If we grow again next quarter I don't want to find out like this.

segments.speaker: Account Manager
segments.text: So — move you onto the volume tier, no monthly cap, and I'll put an alert at eighty percent so you hear it from us first.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: And what's that cost?

segments.speaker: Account Manager
segments.text: More than you're paying now. I'd rather send you the exact number today than give you a range on a call.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Mm. I'd have to justify it, and right now the story internally is the tool broke.

segments.speaker: Account Manager
segments.text: The honest story is you grew and the plan didn't. I'll put the usage curve in the same email, it sort of argues itself.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That would help, yeah. Send it to me and my director.

segments.speaker: Account Manager
segments.text: Today. And I'll put the Manchester seats in separately so you can approve those on their own.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good, because those two go to different people.

segments.speaker: Account Manager
segments.text: Noted. Anything else while I've got you?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No. Get me the numbers and I'll take it from there.
